redox_policy: Quinol chemistry is fixed by independent native DMK/ADOMET-DMK reactions and Rhea specializations. Older primary measurements of extracted quinones do not prove intracellular redox occupancy; no separate oxidase, reductase, hydrogenase or electron donor is invented.
